lines: Tattha apaṇṇakanti ekaṃsikaṃ aviraddhaṃ niyyānikaṃ.
Ṭhānanti kāraṇaṃ.
Kāraṇañhi yasmā tadāyattavuttitāya phalaṃ tiṭṭhati nāma, tasmā “ṭhāna”nti vuccati, “ṭhānañca ṭhānato aṭṭhānañca aṭṭhānato”tiādīsu (vibha. 809) cassa payogo veditabbo.
Iti “apaṇṇakaṃ ṭhāna”nti padadvayenāpi “yaṃ ekantahitasukhāvahattā paṇḍitehi paṭipannaṃ ekaṃsikakāraṇaṃ aviraddhakāraṇaṃ niyyānikakāraṇaṃ, taṃ ida”nti dīpeti.
Ayamettha saṅkhepo, pabhedato pana tīṇi saraṇagamanāni, pañca sīlāni, dasa sīlāni, pātimokkhasaṃvaro, indriyasaṃvaro, ājīvapārisuddhi, paccayapaṭisevanaṃ, sabbampi catupārisuddhisīlaṃ;
indriyesu guttadvāratā, bhojane mattaññutā, jāgariyānuyogo, jhānaṃ, vipassanā, abhiññā, samāpatti, ariyamaggo, ariyaphalaṃ, sabbampetaṃ apaṇṇakaṭṭhānaṃ apaṇṇakapaṭipadā, niyyānikapaṭipadāti attho.
Yasmā ca pana niyyānikapaṭipadāya etaṃ nāmaṃ, tasmāyeva bhagavā apaṇṇakapaṭipadaṃ dassento imaṃ suttamāha –
“Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu apaṇṇakapaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti, yoni cassa āraddhā hoti āsavānaṃ khayāya.
Katamehi tīhi?
Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti, bhojane mattaññū hoti, jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti.
Kathañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti?
Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti…pe… evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti.
“Kathañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bhojane mattaññū hoti?
Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti neva davāya na madāya…pe… evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bhojane mattaññū hoti.
“Kathañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti.
Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya…pe… evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hotī”ti (a. ni. 3.16).
Imasmiñcāpi sutte tayova dhammā vuttā.
Ayaṃ pana apaṇṇakapaṭipadā yāva arahattaphalaṃ labbhateva.
Tattha arahattaphalampi, phalasamāpattivihārassa ceva, anupādāparinibbānassa ca, paṭipadāyeva nāma hoti.
Eketi ekacce paṇḍitamanussā.
Tattha kiñcāpi “asukā nāmā”ti niyamo natthi, idaṃ pana saparisaṃ bodhisattaṃyeva sandhāya vuttanti veditabbaṃ.
Dutiyaṃ āhu takkikāti dutiyanti paṭhamato apaṇṇakaṭṭhānato niyyānikakāraṇato dutiyaṃ takkaggāhakāraṇaṃ aniyyānikakāraṇaṃ.
Āhu takkikāti ettha pana saddhiṃ purimapadena ayaṃ yojanā – apaṇṇakaṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃsikakāraṇaṃ aviraddhakāraṇaṃ niyyānikakāraṇaṃ eke bodhisattappamukhā paṇḍitamanussā gaṇhiṃsu.
Ye pana bālasatthavāhaputtappamukhā takkikā āhu, te dutiyaṃ sāparādhaṃ anekaṃsikaṭṭhānaṃ viraddhakāraṇaṃ aniyyānikakāraṇaṃ aggahesuṃ.
Tesu ye apaṇṇakaṭṭhānaṃ aggahesuṃ, te sukkapaṭipadaṃ paṭipannā.
Ye dutiyaṃ “purato bhavitabbaṃ udakenā”ti takkaggāhasaṅkhātaṃ aniyyānikakāraṇaṃ aggahesuṃ.
Te kaṇhapaṭipadaṃ paṭipannā.
Tattha sukkapaṭipadā aparihānipaṭipadā, kaṇhapaṭipadā parihānipaṭipadā.
Tasmā ye sukkapaṭipadaṃ paṭipannā, te aparihīnā sotthibhāvaṃ pattā.
Ye pana kaṇhapaṭipadaṃ paṭipannā, te parihīnā anayabyasanaṃ āpannāti imamatthaṃ bhagavā anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatino vatvā uttari idamāha “etadaññāya medhāvī, taṃ gaṇhe yadapaṇṇaka”nti.

Tattha etadaññāya medhāvīti “medhā”ti laddhanāmāya vipulāya visuddhāya uttamāya paññāya samannāgato kulaputto etaṃ apaṇṇake ceva sapaṇṇake cāti dvīsu atakkaggāhatakkaggāhasaṅkhātesu ṭhānesu guṇadosaṃ vuddhihāniṃ atthānatthaṃ ñatvāti attho.
Taṃ gaṇhe yadapaṇṇakanti yaṃ apaṇṇakaṃ ekaṃsikaṃ sukkapaṭipadāaparihāniyapaṭipadāsaṅkhātaṃ niyyānikakāraṇaṃ, tadeva gaṇheyya.
Kasmā?
Ekaṃsikādibhāvatoyeva.
Itaraṃ pana na gaṇheyya.
Kasmā?
Anekaṃsikādibhāvatoyeva.
Ayañhi apaṇṇakapaṭipadā nāma sabbesaṃ buddhapaccekabuddhabuddhaputtānaṃ paṭipadā.
Sabbabuddhā hi apaṇṇakapaṭipadāyameva ṭhatvā daḷhena vīriyena pāramiyo pūretvā bodhimūle buddhā nāma honti, paccekabuddhā paccekabodhiṃ uppādenti, buddhaputtā sāvakapāramiñāṇaṃ paṭivijjhanti.
Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa
Khuddakanikāye
Jātaka-aṭṭhakathā

before.title: Jātaka-aṭṭhakathā(Paṭhamo bhāgo)
lines: (Paṭhamo bhāgo)

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Ganthārambhakathā

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Jātikoṭisahassehi, pamāṇarahitaṃ hitaṃ;

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Lokassa lokanāthena, kataṃ yena mahesinā.

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Tassa pāde namassitvā, katvā dhammassa cañjaliṃ;

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Saṅghañca patimānetvā, sabbasammānabhājanaṃ.

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Namassanādino assa, puññassa ratanattaye;

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Pavattassānubhāvena, chetvā sabbe upaddave.

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Taṃ taṃ kāraṇamāgamma, desitāni jutīmatā;

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Apaṇṇakādīni purā, jātakāni mahesinā.

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Yāni yesu ciraṃ satthā, lokanittharaṇatthiko;

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Anante bodhisambhāre, paripācesi nāyako.

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Tāni sabbāni ekajjhaṃ, āropentehi saṅgahaṃ;

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Jātakaṃ nāma saṅgītaṃ, dhammasaṅgāhakehi yaṃ.

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Buddhavaṃsassa etassa, icchantena ciraṭṭhitiṃ;

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Yācito abhigantvāna, therena atthadassinā.

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Asaṃsaṭṭhavihāre, sadā suddhavihārinā;

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Tatheva buddhamittena, santacittena viññunā.

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Mahiṃsāsakavaṃsamhi, sambhūtena nayaññunā;

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Buddhadevena ca tathā, bhikkhunā suddhabuddhinā.

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Mahāpurisacariyānaṃ, ānubhāvaṃ acintiyaṃ;

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Tassa vijjotayantassa, jātakassatthavaṇṇanaṃ.

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Mahāvihāravāsīnaṃ, vācanāmagganissitaṃ;

before.title: Ganthārambhakathā
lines: Bhāsissaṃ bhāsato taṃ me, sādhu gaṇhantu sādhavoti.

before.title: Nidānakathā
lines: Nidānakathā

before.title: Nidānakathā
lines: Sā panāyaṃ jātakassa atthavaṇṇanā dūrenidānaṃ, avidūrenidānaṃ, santikenidānanti imāni tīṇi nidānāni dassetvā vaṇṇiyamānā ye naṃ suṇanti, tehi samudāgamato paṭṭhāya viññātattā yasmā suṭṭhu viññātā nāma hoti, tasmā taṃ tāni nidānāni dassetvā vaṇṇayissāma.

before.title: Nidānakathā
lines: Tattha ādito tāva tesaṃ nidānānaṃ paricchedo veditabbo.
Dīpaṅkarapādamūlasmiñhi katābhinīhārassa mahāsattassa yāva vessantarattabhāvā cavitvā tusitapure nibbatti, tāva pavatto kathāmaggo dūrenidānaṃ nāma.
Tusitabhavanato pana cavitvā yāva bodhimaṇḍe sabbaññutappatti, tāva pavatto kathāmaggo avidūrenidānaṃ nāma.
Santikenidānaṃ pana tesu tesu ṭhānesu viharato tasmiṃ tasmiṃyeva ṭhāne labbhatīti. 1.

before.title: Dūrenidānakathā
lines: Dūrenidānakathā

before.title: Dūrenidānakathā
lines: Tatridaṃ dūrenidānaṃ nāma – ito kira kappasatasahassādhikānaṃ catunnaṃ asaṅkhyeyyānaṃ matthake amaravatī nāma nagaraṃ ahosi.

Tattha sumedho nāma brāhmaṇo paṭivasati ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā kulaparivaṭṭā akkhitto anupakuṭṭho jātivādena abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato.
So aññaṃ kammaṃ akatvā brāhmaṇasippameva uggaṇhi.
Tassa daharakāleyeva mātāpitaro kālamakaṃsu.

Athassa rāsivaḍḍhako amacco āyapotthakaṃ āharitvā suvaṇṇarajatamaṇimuttādibharite gabbhe vivaritvā “ettakaṃ te, kumāra, mātu santakaṃ, ettakaṃ pitu santakaṃ, ettakaṃ ayyakapayyakāna”nti yāva sattamā kulaparivaṭṭā dhanaṃ ācikkhitvā “etaṃ paṭipajjāhī”ti āha.
Sumedhapaṇḍito cintesi –
“imaṃ dhanaṃ saṃharitvā mayhaṃ pitupitāmahādayo paralokaṃ gacchantā ekaṃ kahāpaṇampi gahetvā na gatā, mayā pana gahetvā gamanakāraṇaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭatī”ti.
So rañño ārocetvā nagare bheriṃ carāpetvā mahājanassa dānaṃ datvā tāpasapabbajjaṃ pabbaji.
Imassa panatthassa āvibhāvatthaṃ imasmiṃ ṭhāne sumedhakathā kathetabbā.
Sā panesā kiñcāpi buddhavaṃse nirantaraṃ āgatāyeva, gāthāsambandhena pana āgatattā na suṭṭhu pākaṭā.
Tasmā taṃ antarantarā gāthāya sambandhadīpakehi vacanehi saddhiṃ kathessāma.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Sumedhakathā

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Kappasatasahassādhikānañhi catunnaṃ asaṅkhyeyyānaṃ matthake dasahi saddehi avivittaṃ “amaravatī”ti ca “amara”nti ca laddhanāmaṃ nagaraṃ ahosi, yaṃ sandhāya buddhavaṃse vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Kappe ca satasahasse, caturo ca asaṅkhiye;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Amaraṃ nāma nagaraṃ, dassaneyyaṃ manoramaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Dasahi saddehi avivittaṃ, annapānasamāyuta”nti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tattha dasahi saddehi avivittanti hatthisaddena, assasaddena, rathasaddena, bherisaddena, mudiṅgasaddena, vīṇāsaddena, sammasaddena, tāḷasaddena, saṅkhasaddena “asnātha, pivatha, khādathā”ti dasamena saddenāti imehi dasahi saddehi avivittaṃ ahosi.
Tesaṃ pana saddānaṃ ekadesameva gahetvā –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Hatthisaddaṃ assasaddaṃ, bherisaṅkharathāni ca;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Khādatha pivatha ceva, annapānena ghosita”nti. –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Buddhavaṃse imaṃ gāthaṃ vatvā –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Nagaraṃ sabbaṅgasampannaṃ, sabbakammamupāgataṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Sattaratanasampannaṃ, nānājanasamākulaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Samiddhaṃ devanagaraṃva, āvāsaṃ puññakamminaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Nagare amaravatiyā, sumedho nāma brāhmaṇo;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Anekakoṭisannicayo, pahūtadhanadhaññavā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Ajjhāyako mantadharo, tiṇṇaṃ vedāna pāragū;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Lakkhaṇe itihāse ca, sadhamme pāramiṃ gato”ti. –
vuttaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Athekadivasaṃ so sumedhapaṇḍito uparipāsādavaratale rahogato hutvā pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā nisinno cintesi –

“punabbhave, paṇḍita, paṭisandhiggahaṇaṃ nāma dukkhaṃ, tathā nibbattanibbattaṭṭhāne sarīrabhedanaṃ, ahañca jātidhammo jarādhammo byādhidhammo maraṇadhammo, evaṃbhūtena mayā ajātiṃ ajaraṃ abyādhiṃ adukkhaṃ sukhaṃ sītalaṃ amatamahānibbānaṃ pariyesituṃ vaṭṭati, avassaṃ bhavato muccitvā nibbānagāminā ekena maggena bhavitabba”nti.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Rahogato nisīditvā, evaṃ cintesahaṃ tadā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Dukkho punabbhavo nāma, sarīrassa ca bhedanaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Jātidhammo jarādhammo, byādhidhammo sahaṃ tadā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Ajaraṃ amataṃ khemaṃ, pariyesissāmi nibbutiṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yaṃnūnimaṃ pūtikāyaṃ, nānākuṇapapūritaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Chaḍḍayitvāna gaccheyyaṃ, anapekkho anatthiko.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Atthi hehiti so maggo, na so sakkā na hetuye;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Pariyesissāmi taṃ maggaṃ, bhavato parimuttiyā”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tato uttaripi evaṃ cintesi – yathā hi loke dukkhassa paṭipakkhabhūtaṃ sukhaṃ nāma atthi, evaṃ bhave sati tappaṭipakkhena vibhavenāpi bhavitabbaṃ.
Yathā ca uṇhe sati tassa vūpasamabhūtaṃ sītampi atthi, evaṃ rāgādīnaṃ aggīnaṃ vūpasamena nibbānenāpi bhavitabbaṃ.
Yathā ca pāpassa lāmakassa dhammassa paṭipakkhabhūto kalyāṇo anavajjadhammopi atthiyeva, evameva pāpikāya jātiyā sati sabbajātikkhepanato ajātisaṅkhātena nibbānenāpi bhavitabbamevāti.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathāpi dukkhe vijjante, sukhaṃ nāmapi vijjati;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Evaṃ bhave vijjamāne, vibhavopi icchitabbako.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathāpi uṇhe vijjante, aparaṃ vijjati sītalaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Evaṃ tividhaggi vijjante, nibbānaṃ icchitabbakaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathāpi pāpe vijjante, kalyāṇamapi vijjati;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Evameva jāti vijjante, ajātipicchitabbaka”nti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Aparampi cintesi – yathā nāma gūtharāsimhi nimuggena purisena dūrato pañcavaṇṇapadumasañchannaṃ mahātaḷākaṃ disvā “katarena nu kho maggena ettha gantabba”nti taṃ taḷākaṃ gavesituṃ yuttaṃ.
Yaṃ tassa agavesanaṃ, na so taḷākassa doso.
Evameva kilesamaladhovane amatamahānibbānataḷāke vijjante tassa agavesanaṃ na amatanibbānamahātaḷākassa doso.
Yathā ca corehi samparivārito puriso palāyanamagge vijjamānepi sace na palāyati, na so maggassa doso, purisasseva doso.
Evameva kilesehi parivāretvā gahitassa purisassa vijjamāneyeva nibbānagāmimhi sive magge maggassa agavesanaṃ nāma na maggassa doso, puggalasseva doso.
Yathā ca byādhipīḷito puriso vijjamāne byādhitikicchake vejje sace taṃ vejjaṃ gavesitvā byādhiṃ na tikicchāpeti, na so vejjassa doso, purisasseva doso.
Evameva yo kilesabyādhipīḷito puriso kilesavūpasamamaggakovidaṃ vijjamānameva ācariyaṃ na gavesati, tasseva doso, na kilesavināsakassa ācariyassāti.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathā gūthagato puriso, taḷākaṃ disvāna pūritaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Na gavesati taṃ taḷākaṃ, na doso taḷākassa so.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Evaṃ kilesamaladhove, vijjante amatantaḷe;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Na gavesati taṃ taḷākaṃ, na doso amatantaḷe.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathā arīhi pariruddho, vijjante gamanampathe;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Na palāyati so puriso, na doso añjasassa so.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Evaṃ kilesapariruddho, vijjamāne sive pathe;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Na gavesati taṃ maggaṃ, na doso sivamañjase.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathāpi byādhito puriso, vijjamāne tikicchake;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Na tikicchāpeti taṃ byādhiṃ, na doso so tikicchake.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Evaṃ kilesabyādhīhi, dukkhito paripīḷito;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Na gavesati taṃ ācariyaṃ, na doso so vināyake”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Aparampi cintesi – yathā maṇḍanajātiko puriso kaṇṭhe āsattaṃ kuṇapaṃ chaḍḍetvā sukhī gacchati, evaṃ mayāpi imaṃ pūtikāyaṃ chaḍḍetvā anapekkhena nibbānanagaraṃ pavisitabbaṃ.

Yathā ca naranāriyo ukkārabhūmiyaṃ uccārapassāvaṃ katvā na taṃ ucchaṅgena vā ādāya dasantena vā veṭhetvā gacchanti, jigucchamānā pana anapekkhāva chaḍḍetvā gacchanti, evaṃ mayāpi imaṃ pūtikāyaṃ anapekkhena chaḍḍetvā amataṃ nibbānanagaraṃ pavisituṃ vaṭṭati.
Yathā ca nāvikā nāma jajjaraṃ nāvaṃ anapekkhā chaḍḍetvā gacchanti, evaṃ ahampi imaṃ navahi vaṇamukhehi paggharantaṃ kāyaṃ chaḍḍetvā anapekkho nibbānapuraṃ pavisissāmi.
Yathā ca puriso nānāratanāni ādāya corehi saddhiṃ maggaṃ gacchanto attano ratananāsabhayena te chaḍḍetvā khemaṃ maggaṃ gaṇhāti, evaṃ ayampi karajakāyo ratanavilopakacorasadiso.
Sacāhaṃ ettha taṇhaṃ karissāmi, ariyamaggakusaladhammaratanaṃ me nassissati.
Tasmā mayā imaṃ corasadisaṃ kāyaṃ chaḍḍetvā nibbānanagaraṃ pavisituṃ vaṭṭatīti.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathāpi kuṇapaṃ puriso, kaṇṭhe baddhaṃ jigucchiya;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Mocayitvāna gaccheyya, sukhī serī sayaṃvasī.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Tathevimaṃ pūtikāyaṃ, nānākuṇapasañcayaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Chaḍḍayitvāna gaccheyyaṃ, anapekkho anatthiko.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathā uccāraṭṭhānamhi, karīsaṃ naranāriyo;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Chaḍḍayitvāna gacchanti, anapekkhā anatthikā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Evamevāhaṃ imaṃ kāyaṃ, nānākuṇapapūritaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Chaḍḍayitvāna gacchissaṃ, vaccaṃ katvā yathā kuṭiṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathāpi jajjaraṃ nāvaṃ, paluggaṃ udagāhiniṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Sāmī chaḍḍetvā gacchanti, anapekkhā anatthikā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Evamevāhaṃ imaṃ kāyaṃ, navacchiddaṃ dhuvassavaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Chaḍḍayitvāna gacchissaṃ, jiṇṇanāvaṃva sāmikā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathāpi puriso corehi, gacchanto bhaṇḍamādiya;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Bhaṇḍacchedabhayaṃ disvā, chaḍḍayitvāna gacchati.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Evameva ayaṃ kāyo, mahācorasamo viya;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Pahāyimaṃ gamissāmi, kusalacchedanābhayā”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Evaṃ sumedhapaṇḍito nānāvidhāhi upamāhi imaṃ nekkhammūpasaṃhitaṃ atthaṃ cintetvā sakanivesane aparimitaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ heṭṭhā vuttanayena kapaṇaddhikādīnaṃ vissajjetvā mahādānaṃ datvā vatthukāme ca kilesakāme ca pahāya amaranagarato nikkhamitvā ekakova himavante dhammikaṃ nāma pabbataṃ nissāya assamaṃ katvā tattha paṇṇasālañca caṅkamañca māpetvā pañcahi nīvaraṇadosehi vivajjitaṃ “evaṃ samāhite citte”tiādinā nayena vuttehi aṭṭhahi kāraṇaguṇehi samupetaṃ abhiññāsaṅkhātaṃ balaṃ āharituṃ tasmiṃ assamapade navadosasamannāgataṃ sāṭakaṃ pajahitvā dvādasaguṇasamannāgataṃ vākacīraṃ nivāsetvā isipabbajjaṃ pabbaji.

Evaṃ pabbajito aṭṭhadosasamākiṇṇaṃ taṃ paṇṇasālaṃ pahāya dasaguṇasamannāgataṃ rukkhamūlaṃ upagantvā sabbaṃ dhaññavikatiṃ pahāya pavattaphalabhojano hutvā nisajjaṭṭhānacaṅkamanavaseneva padhānaṃ padahanto sattāhabbhantareyeva aṭṭhannaṃ samāpattīnaṃ pañcannañca abhiññānaṃ lābhī ahosi.
Evaṃ taṃ yathāpatthitaṃ abhiññābalaṃ pāpuṇi.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Evāhaṃ cintayitvāna, nekakoṭisataṃ dhanaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Nāthānāthānaṃ datvāna, himavantamupāgamiṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Himavantassāvidūre, dhammiko nāma pabbato;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Assamo sukato mayhaṃ, paṇṇasālā sumāpitā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Caṅkamaṃ tattha māpesiṃ, pañcadosavivajjitaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Aṭṭhaguṇasamupetaṃ, abhiññābalamāhariṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Sāṭakaṃ pajahiṃ tattha, navadosamupāgataṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Vākacīraṃ nivāsesiṃ, dvādasaguṇamupāgataṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Aṭṭhadosasamākiṇṇaṃ, pajahiṃ paṇṇasālakaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Upāgamiṃ rukkhamūlaṃ, guṇe dasahupāgataṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Vāpitaṃ ropitaṃ dhaññaṃ, pajahiṃ niravasesato;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Anekaguṇasampannaṃ, pavattaphalamādiyiṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Tatthappadhānaṃ padahiṃ, nisajjaṭṭhānacaṅkame;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Abbhantaramhi sattāhe, abhiññābalapāpuṇi”nti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tattha “assamo sukato mayhaṃ, paṇṇasālā sumāpitā”ti imāya pāḷiyā sumedhapaṇḍitena assamapaṇṇasālācaṅkamā sahatthā māpitā viya vuttā.
Ayaṃ panettha attho – mahāsattaṃ “himavantaṃ ajjhogāhetvā ajja dhammikaṃ pabbataṃ pavisissāmī”ti nikkhantaṃ disvā sakko devānamindo vissakammadevaputtaṃ āmantesi –
“tāta, ayaṃ sumedhapaṇḍito pabbajissāmīti nikkhanto, etassa vasanaṭṭhānaṃ māpehī”ti.
So tassa vacanaṃ sampaṭicchitvā ramaṇīyaṃ assamaṃ, suguttaṃ paṇṇasālaṃ, manoramaṃ caṅkamañca māpesi.
Bhagavā pana tadā attano puññānubhāvena nipphannaṃ taṃ assamapadaṃ sandhāya sāriputta, tasmiṃ dhammikapabbate –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Assamo sukato mayhaṃ, paṇṇasālā sumāpitā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Caṅkamaṃ tattha māpesiṃ, pañcadosavivajjita”nti. –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Āha.
Tattha sukato mayhanti sukato mayā.
Paṇṇasālā sumāpitāti paṇṇacchadanasālāpi me sumāpitā ahosi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Pañcadosavivajjitanti pañcime caṅkamadosā nāma – thaddhavisamatā, antorukkhatā, gahanacchannatā, atisambādhatā, ativisālatāti.
Thaddhavisamabhūmibhāgasmiñhi caṅkame caṅkamantassa pādā rujjanti, phoṭā uṭṭhahanti, cittaṃ ekaggaṃ na labhati, kammaṭṭhānaṃ vipajjati.
Mudusamatale pana phāsuvihāraṃ āgamma kammaṭṭhānaṃ sampajjati.
Tasmā thaddhavisamabhūmibhāgatā eko dosoti veditabbo.
Caṅkamassa anto vā majjhe vā koṭiyaṃ vā rukkhe sati pamādamāgamma caṅkamantassa nalāṭaṃ vā sīsaṃ vā paṭihaññatīti antorukkhatā dutiyo doso.
Tiṇalatādigahanacchanne caṅkame caṅkamanto andhakāravelāyaṃ uragādike pāṇe akkamitvā vā māreti, tehi vā daṭṭho dukkhaṃ āpajjatīti gahanacchannatā tatiyo doso.
Atisambādhe caṅkame vitthārato ratanike vā aḍḍharatanike vā caṅkamantassa paricchede pakkhalitvā nakhāpi aṅguliyopi bhijjantīti atisambādhatā catuttho doso.
Ativisāle caṅkame caṅkamantassa cittaṃ vidhāvati, ekaggataṃ na labhatīti ativisālatā pañcamo doso.

Puthulato pana diyaḍḍharatanaṃ dvīsu passesu ratanamattaanucaṅkamaṃ dīghato saṭṭhihatthaṃ mudutalaṃ samavippakiṇṇavālukaṃ caṅkamaṃ vaṭṭati cetiyagirimhi dīpappasādakamahindattherassa caṅkamanaṃ viya, tādisaṃ taṃ ahosi.
Tenāha “caṅkamaṃ tattha māpesiṃ, pañcadosavivajjita”nti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Aṭṭhaguṇasamupetanti aṭṭhahi samaṇasukhehi upetaṃ.

Aṭṭhimāni samaṇasukhāni nāma – dhanadhaññapariggahābhāvo, anavajjapiṇḍapātapariyesanabhāvo, nibbutapiṇḍapātabhuñjanabhāvo, raṭṭhaṃ pīḷetvā dhanasāraṃ vā sīsakahāpaṇādīni vā gaṇhantesu rājakulesu raṭṭhapīḷanakilesābhāvo, upakaraṇesu nicchandarāgabhāvo, coravilope nibbhayabhāvo, rājarājamahāmattehi asaṃsaṭṭhabhāvo, catūsu disāsu appaṭihatabhāvoti.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – yathā tasmiṃ assame vasantena sakkā honti imāni aṭṭha samaṇasukhāni vindituṃ, evaṃ aṭṭhaguṇasamupetaṃ taṃ assamaṃ māpesinti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Abhiññābalamāharinti pacchā tasmiṃ assame vasanto kasiṇaparikammaṃ katvā abhiññānaṃ samāpattīnañca uppādanatthāya aniccato dukkhato vipassanaṃ ārabhitvā thāmappattaṃ vipassanābalaṃ āhariṃ.
Yathā tasmiṃ vasanto taṃ balaṃ āharituṃ sakkomi, evaṃ taṃ assamaṃ tassa abhiññatthāya vipassanābalassa anucchavikaṃ katvā māpesinti attho.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Sāṭakaṃ pajahiṃ tattha, navadosamupāgatanti etthāyaṃ anupubbikathā – tadā kira kuṭileṇacaṅkamādipaṭimaṇḍitaṃ pupphūpagaphalūpagarukkhasañchannaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ madhurasalilāsayaṃ apagatavāḷamigabhiṃsanakasakuṇaṃ pavivekakkhamaṃ assamaṃ māpetvā alaṅkatacaṅkamassa ubhosu antesu ālambanaphalakaṃ saṃvidhāya nisīdanatthāya caṅkamavemajjhe samatalaṃ muggavaṇṇasilaṃ māpetvā antopaṇṇasālāyaṃ jaṭāmaṇḍalavākacīratidaṇḍakuṇḍikādike tāpasaparikkhāre, maṇḍape pānīyaghaṭapānīyasaṅkhapānīyasarāvāni, aggisālāyaṃ aṅgārakapalladāruādīnīti evaṃ yaṃ yaṃ pabbajitānaṃ upakārāya saṃvattati, taṃ taṃ sabbaṃ māpetvā paṇṇasālāya bhittiyaṃ “ye keci pabbajitukāmā ime parikkhāre gahetvā pabbajantū”ti akkharāni chinditvā devalokameva gate vissakammadevaputte sumedhapaṇḍito himavantapabbatapāde girikandarānusārena attano nivāsānurūpaṃ phāsukaṭṭhānaṃ olokento nadīnivattane vissakammanimmitaṃ sakkadattiyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ assamaṃ disvā caṅkamanakoṭiṃ gantvā padavalañjaṃ apassanto “dhuvaṃ pabbajitā dhuragāme bhikkhaṃ pariyesitvā kilantarūpā āgantvā paṇṇasālaṃ pavisitvā nisinnā bhavissantī”ti cintetvā thokaṃ āgametvā “ativiya cirāyanti, jānissāmī”ti paṇṇāsālākuṭidvāraṃ vivaritvā anto pavisitvā ito cito ca olokento mahābhittiyaṃ akkharāni vācetvā “mayhaṃ kappiyaparikkhārā ete, ime gahetvā pabbajissāmī”ti attano nivatthapārutaṃ sāṭakayugaṃ pajahi.
Tenāha “sāṭakaṃ pajahiṃ tatthā”ti.
Evaṃ paviṭṭho ahaṃ, sāriputta, tassaṃ paṇṇasālāyaṃ sāṭakaṃ pajahiṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Navadosamupāgatanti sāṭakaṃ pajahanto nava dose disvā pajahinti dīpeti.
Tāpasapabbajjaṃ pabbajitānañhi sāṭakasmiṃ nava dosā upaṭṭhahanti.
Tesu tassa mahagghabhāvo eko doso, parapaṭibaddhatāya uppajjanabhāvo eko, paribhogena lahuṃ kilissanabhāvo eko.
Kiliṭṭho hi dhovitabbo ca rajitabbo ca hoti.
Paribhogena jīraṇabhāvo eko.
Jiṇṇassa hi tunnaṃ vā aggaḷadānaṃ vā kātabbaṃ hoti.
Puna pariyesanāya durabhisambhavabhāvo eko, tāpasapabbajjāya asāruppabhāvo eko, paccatthikānaṃ sādhāraṇabhāvo eko.
Yathā hi naṃ paccatthikā na gaṇhanti, evaṃ gopetabbo hoti.
Paribhuñjantassa vibhūsanaṭṭhānabhāvo eko, gahetvā vicarantassa khandhabhāramahicchabhāvo ekoti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Vākacīraṃ nivāsesinti tadāhaṃ, sāriputta, ime nava dose disvā sāṭakaṃ pahāya vākacīraṃ nivāsesiṃ, muñjatiṇaṃ hīraṃ hīraṃ katvā ganthetvā katavākacīraṃ nivāsanapārupanatthāya ādiyinti attho.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Dvādasaguṇamupāgatanti dvādasahi ānisaṃsehi samannāgataṃ.

Vākacīrasmiñhi dvādasa ānisaṃsā – appagghaṃ sundaraṃ kappiyanti ayaṃ tāva eko ānisaṃso, sahatthā kātuṃ sakkāti ayaṃ dutiyo, paribhogena saṇikaṃ kilissati, dhoviyamānepi papañco natthīti ayaṃ tatiyo, paribhogena jiṇṇepi sibbitabbābhāvo catuttho, puna pariyesantassa sukhena karaṇabhāvo pañcamo, tāpasapabbajjāya sāruppabhāvo chaṭṭho, paccatthikānaṃ nirupabhogabhāvo sattamo, paribhuñjantassa vibhūsanaṭṭhānābhāvo aṭṭhamo, dhāraṇe sallahukabhāvo navamo, cīvarapaccaye appicchabhāvo dasamo, vākuppattiyā dhammikaanavajjabhāvo ekādasamo, vākacīre naṭṭhepi anapekkhabhāvo dvādasamoti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Aṭṭhadosasamākiṇṇaṃ, pajahiṃ paṇṇasālakanti.
Kathaṃ pajahi?

So kira varasāṭakayugaṃ omuñcitvā cīvaravaṃse laggitaṃ anojapupphadāmasadisaṃ rattaṃ vākacīraṃ gahetvā nivāsetvā, tassūpari aparaṃ suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ vākacīraṃ paridahitvā, punnāgapupphasantharasadisaṃ sakhuraṃ ajinacammaṃ ekaṃsaṃ katvā jaṭāmaṇḍalaṃ paṭimuñcitvā cūḷāya saddhiṃ niccalabhāvakaraṇatthaṃ sārasūciṃ pavesetvā muttajālasadisāya sikkāya pavāḷavaṇṇaṃ kuṇḍikaṃ odahitvā tīsu ṭhānesu vaṅkakājaṃ ādāya ekissā kājakoṭiyā kuṇḍikaṃ, ekissā aṅkusapacchitidaṇḍakādīni olaggetvā khāribhāraṃ aṃse katvā, dakkhiṇena hatthena kattaradaṇḍaṃ gahetvā paṇṇasālato nikkhamitvā saṭṭhihatthe mahācaṅkame aparāparaṃ caṅkamanto attano vesaṃ oloketvā –

“mayhaṃ manoratho matthakaṃ patto, sobhati vata me pabbajjā, buddhapaccekabuddhādīhi sabbehi dhīrapurisehi vaṇṇitā thomitā ayaṃ pabbajjā nāma, pahīnaṃ me gihibandhanaṃ, nikkhantosmi nekkhammaṃ, laddhā me uttamapabbajjā, karissāmi samaṇadhammaṃ, labhissāmi maggaphalasukha”nti ussāhajāto khārikājaṃ otāretvā caṅkamavemajjhe muggavaṇṇasilāpaṭṭe suvaṇṇapaṭimā viya nisinno divasabhāgaṃ vītināmetvā sāyanhasamayaṃ paṇṇasālaṃ pavisitvā, bidalamañcakapasse kaṭṭhattharikāya nipanno sarīraṃ utuṃ gāhāpetvā, balavapaccūse pabujjhitvā attano āgamanaṃ āvajjesi “ahaṃ gharāvāse ādīnavaṃ disvā amitabhogaṃ anantayasaṃ pahāya araññaṃ pavisitvā nekkhammagavesako hutvā pabbajito, ito dāni paṭṭhāya pamādacāraṃ carituṃ na vaṭṭati.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Pavivekañhi pahāya vicarantaṃ micchāvitakkamakkhikā khādanti, idāni mayā vivekamanubrūhetuṃ vaṭṭati.

Ahañhi gharāvāsaṃ palibodhato disvā nikkhanto, ayañca manāpā paṇṇasālā, beluvapakkavaṇṇaparibhaṇḍakatā bhūmi, rajatavaṇṇā setabhittiyo, kapotapādavaṇṇaṃ paṇṇacchadanaṃ, vicittattharaṇavaṇṇo bidalamañcako, nivāsaphāsukaṃ vasanaṭṭhānaṃ, na etto atirekatarā viya me gehasampadā paññāyatī”ti paṇṇasālāya dose vicinanto aṭṭha dose passi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Paṇṇasālāparibhogasmiñhi aṭṭha ādīnavā – mahāsamārambhena dabbasambhāre samodhānetvā karaṇapariyesanabhāvo eko ādīnavo, tiṇapaṇṇamattikāsu patitāsu tāsaṃ punappunaṃ ṭhapetabbatāya nibandhajagganabhāvo dutiyo, senāsanaṃ nāma mahallakassa pāpuṇāti, avelāya vuṭṭhāpiyamānassa cittekaggatā na hotīti uṭṭhāpaniyabhāvo tatiyo, sītuṇhapaṭighātena kāyassa sukhumālakaraṇabhāvo catuttho, gehaṃ paviṭṭhena yaṃkiñci pāpaṃ sakkā kātunti garahāpaṭicchādanabhāvo pañcamo, “mayha”nti pariggahakaraṇabhāvo chaṭṭho, gehassa atthibhāvo nāma sadutiyakavāsoti sattamo, ūkāmaṅgulagharagoḷikādīnaṃ sādhāraṇatāya bahusādhāraṇabhāvo aṭṭhamo.
Iti ime aṭṭha ādīnave disvā mahāsatto paṇṇasālaṃ pajati.
Tenāha “aṭṭhadosasamākiṇṇaṃ, pajahiṃ paṇṇasālaka”nti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Upāgamiṃ rukkhamūlaṃ, guṇe dasahupāgatanti channaṃ paṭikkhipitvā dasahi guṇehi upetaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ upagatosmīti vadati.
Tatrime dasa guṇā – appasamārambhatā eko guṇo, upagamanamattakameva hi tattha hoti;
apaṭijagganatā dutiyo, tañhi sammaṭṭhampi asammaṭṭhampi paribhogaphāsukaṃ hotiyeva.
Anuṭṭhāpariyabhāvo tatiyo, garahaṃ nappaṭicchādeti;
tattha hi pāpaṃ karonto lajjatīti garahāya appaṭicchannabhāvo catuttho;
abbhokāsavāso viya kāyaṃ na santhambhetīti kāyassa asanthambhanabhāvo pañcamo;
pariggahakaraṇābhāvo chaṭṭho;
gehālayapaṭikkhepo sattamo;
bahusādhāraṇagehe viya “paṭijaggissāmi naṃ, nikkhamathā”ti nīharaṇakābhāvo aṭṭhamo;
vasantassa sappītikabhāvo navamo;
rukkhamūlasenāsanassa gatagataṭṭhāne sulabhatāya anapekkhabhāvo dasamoti ime dasa guṇe disvā rukkhamūlaṃ upāgatosmīti vadati.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Imāni ettakāni kāraṇāni sallakkhetvā mahāsatto punadivase bhikkhāya gāmaṃ pāvisi.
Athassa sampattagāme manussā mahantena ussāhena bhikkhaṃ adaṃsu.
So bhattakiccaṃ niṭṭhāpetvā assamaṃ āgamma nisīditvā cintesi “nāhaṃ āhāraṃ na labhāmīti pabbajito, siniddhāhāro nāmesa mānamadapurisamade vaḍḍheti, āhāramūlakassa ca dukkhassa anto natthi.
Yaṃnūnāhaṃ vāpitaropitadhaññanibbattaṃ āhāraṃ pajahitvā pavattaphalabhojano bhaveyya”nti.
So tato ṭṭhāya tathā katvā ghaṭento vāyamanto sattāhabbhantareyeva aṭṭha samāpattiyo pañca abhiññāyo ca nibbattesi.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Vāpitaṃ ropitaṃ dhaññaṃ, pajahiṃ niravasesato;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Anekaguṇasampannaṃ, pavattaphalamādiyiṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Tatthappadhānaṃ padahiṃ, nisajjaṭṭhānacaṅkame;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Abbhantaramhi sattāhe, abhiññābalapāpuṇi”nti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Evaṃ abhiññābalaṃ patvā sumedhatāpase samāpattisukhena vītināmente dīpaṅkaro nāma satthā loke udapādi.
Tassa paṭisandhijātisambodhidhammacakkappavattanesu sakalāpi dasasahassī lokadhātu saṃkampi sampakampi sampavedhi, mahāviravaṃ viravi, dvattiṃsa pubbanimittāni pāturahesuṃ.
Sumedhatāpaso samāpattisukhena vītināmento neva taṃ saddamassosi, na tāni nimittāni addasa.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Evaṃ me siddhippattassa, vasībhūtassa sāsane;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Dīpaṅkaro nāma jino, uppajji lokanāyako.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Uppajjante ca jāyante, bujjhante dhammadesane;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Caturo nimitte nāddasaṃ, jhānaratisamappito”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tasmiṃ kāle dīpaṅkaradasabalo catūhi khīṇāsavasatasahassehi parivuto anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno rammaṃ nāma nagaraṃ patvā sudassanamahāvihāre paṭivasati.

Rammanagaravāsino “dīpaṅkaro kira samaṇissaro paramātisambodhiṃ patvā pavattavaradhammacakko anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno rammanagaraṃ patvā sudassanamahāvihāre paṭivasatī”ti sutvā sappinavanītādīni ceva bhesajjāni vatthacchādanāni ca gāhāpetvā gandhamālādihatthā yena buddho, yena dhammo, yena saṅgho, tanninnā tappoṇā tappabbhārā hutvā satthāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā vanditvā gandhamālādīhi pūjetvā ekamantaṃ nisinnā dhammadesanaṃ sutvā svātanāya nimantetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃsu.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Te punadivase mahādānaṃ sajjetvā nagaraṃ alaṅkaritvā dasabalassa āgamanamaggaṃ alaṅkarontā udakabhinnaṭṭhānesu paṃsuṃ pakkhipitvā samaṃ bhūmitalaṃ katvā rajatapaṭṭavaṇṇaṃ vālukaṃ ākiranti, lājāni ceva pupphāni ca vikiranti, nānāvirāgehi vatthehi dhajapaṭāke ussāpenti, kadaliyo ceva puṇṇaghaṭapantiyo ca patiṭṭhāpenti.

Tasmiṃ kāle sumedhatāpaso attano assamapadā uggantvā tesaṃ manussānaṃ uparibhāgena ākāsena gacchanto te haṭṭhatuṭṭhe manusse disvā “kiṃ nu kho kāraṇa”nti ākāsato oruyha ekamantaṃ ṭhito manusse pucchi –
“ambho kassa tumhe imaṃ maggaṃ alaṅkarothā”ti?
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Paccantadesavisaye, nimantetvā tathāgataṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tassa āgamanaṃ maggaṃ, sodhenti tuṭṭhamānasā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Ahaṃ tena samayena, nikkhamitvā sakassamā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Dhunanto vākacīrāni, gacchāmi ambare tadā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Vedajātaṃ janaṃ disvā, tuṭṭhahaṭṭhaṃ pamoditaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Orohitvāna gaganā, manusse pucchi tāvade.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “‘Tuṭṭhahaṭṭho pamudito, vedajāto mahājano;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Kassa sodhīyati maggo, añjasaṃ vaṭumāyana’”nti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Manussā āhaṃsu “bhante sumedha, na tvaṃ jānāsi, dīpaṅkaradasabalo sammāsambodhiṃ patvā pavattitavaradhammacakko cārikaṃ caramāno amhākaṃ nagaraṃ patvā sudassanamahāvihāre paṭivasati.
Mayaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ nimantayimhā, tassetaṃ buddhassa bhagavato āgamanamaggaṃ alaṅkaromā”ti.
Sumedhatāpaso cintesi –
“buddhoti kho ghosamattakampi loke dullabhaṃ, pageva buddhuppādo, mayāpi imehi manussehi saddhiṃ dasabalassa maggaṃ alaṅkarituṃ vaṭṭatī”ti.
So te manusse āha –
“sace bho tumhe etaṃ maggaṃ buddhassa alaṅkarotha, mayhampi ekaṃ okāsaṃ detha, ahampi tumhehi saddhiṃ maggaṃ alaṅkarissāmī”ti.
Te “sādhū”ti sampaṭicchitvā “sumedhatāpaso iddhimā”ti jānantā udakabhinnokāsaṃ sallakkhetvā “tvaṃ imaṃ ṭhānaṃ alaṅkarohī”ti adaṃsu.

Sumedho buddhārammaṇaṃ pītiṃ gahetvā cintesi “ahaṃ imaṃ okāsaṃ iddhiyā alaṅkarituṃ sakkomi, evaṃ alaṅkato pana mama manaṃ na paritosessati, ajja mayā kāyaveyyāvaccaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭatī”ti paṃsuṃ āharitvā tasmiṃ padese pakkhipi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tassa tasmiṃ padese analaṅkateyeva dīpaṅkaro dasabalo mahānubhāvānaṃ chaḷabhiññānaṃ khīṇāsavānaṃ catūhi satasahassehi parivuto devatāsu dibbagandhamālādīhi pūjayantīsu dibbasaṅgītesu pavattantesu manussesu mānusakagandhehi ceva mālādīhi ca pūjayantesu anantāya buddhalīḷāya manosilātale vijambhamāno sīho viya taṃ alaṅkatapaṭiyattaṃ maggaṃ paṭipajji.

Sumedhatāpaso akkhīni ummīletvā alaṅkatamaggena āgacchantassa dasabalassa dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇapaṭimaṇḍitaṃ asītiyā anubyañjanehi anurañjitaṃ byāmappabhāya samparivāritaṃ maṇivaṇṇagaganatale nānappakārā vijjulatā viya āveḷāveḷabhūtā ceva yugalayugalabhūtā ca chabbaṇṇaghanabuddharasmiyo vissajjentaṃ rūpaggappattaṃ attabhāvaṃ oloketvā “ajja mayā dasabalassa jīvitapariccāgaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati, mā bhagavā kalalaṃ akkami, maṇiphalakasetuṃ pana akkamanto viya saddhiṃ catūhi khīṇāsavasatasahassehi mama piṭṭhiṃ maddamāno gacchatu, taṃ me bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā”ti kese mocetvā ajinacammajaṭāmaṇḍalavākacīrāni kāḷavaṇṇe kalale pattharitvā maṇiphalakasetu viya kalalapiṭṭhe nipajji.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Te me puṭṭhā viyākaṃsu, ‘buddho loke anuttaro;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Dīpaṅkaro nāma jino, uppajji lokanāyako;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tassa sodhīyati maggo, añjasaṃ vaṭumāyanaṃ’.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Buddhoti mama sutvāna, pīti uppajji tāvade;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Buddho buddhoti kathayanto, somanassaṃ pavedayiṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Tattha ṭhatvā vicintesiṃ, tuṭṭho saṃviggamānaso;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Idha bījāni ropissaṃ, khaṇo eva mā upaccagā’.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yadi buddhassa sodhetha, ekokāsaṃ dadātha me;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Ahampi sodhayissāmi, añjasaṃ vaṭumāyanaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Adaṃsu te mamokāsaṃ, sodhetuṃ añjasaṃ tadā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Buddho buddhoti cintento, maggaṃ sodhemahaṃ tadā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Aniṭṭhite mamokāse, dīpaṅkaro mahāmuni;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Catūhi satasahassehi, chaḷabhiññehi tādihi;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Khīṇāsavehi vimalehi, paṭipajji añjasaṃ jino.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Paccuggamanā vattanti, vajjanti bheriyo bahū;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Āmoditā naramarū, sādhukāraṃ pavattayuṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Devā manusse passanti, manussāpi ca devatā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Ubhopi te pañjalikā, anuyanti tathāgataṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Devā dibbehi turiyehi, manussā mānusehi ca;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Ubhopi te vajjayantā, anuyanti tathāgataṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Dibbaṃ mandāravaṃ pupphaṃ, padumaṃ pārichattakaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Disodisaṃ okiranti, ākāsanabhagatā marū.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Campakaṃ salalaṃ nīpaṃ, nāgapunnāgaketakaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Disodisaṃ ukkhipanti, bhūmitalagatā narā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Kese muñcitvāhaṃ tattha, vākacīrañca cammakaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Kalale pattharitvāna, avakujjo nipajjahaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Akkamitvāna maṃ buddho, saha sissehi gacchatu;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Mā naṃ kalale akkamittho, hitāya me bhavissatī”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: So kalalapiṭṭhe nipannakova puna akkhīni ummīletvā dīpaṅkaradasabalassa buddhasiriṃ sampassamāno evaṃ cintesi –
“sacāhaṃ iccheyyaṃ, sabbakilese jhāpetvā saṅghanavako hutvā rammanagaraṃ paviseyyaṃ.
Aññātakavesena pana me kilese jhāpetvā nibbānappattiyā kiccaṃ natthi.
Yaṃnūnāhaṃ dīpaṅkaradasabalo viya paramābhisambodhiṃ patvā dhammanāvaṃ āropetvā mahājanaṃ saṃsārasāgarā uttāretvā pacchā parinibbāyeyyaṃ, idaṃ mayhaṃ patirūpa”nti.
Tato aṭṭha dhamme samodhānetvā buddhabhāvāya abhinīhāraṃ katvā nipajji.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Pathaviyaṃ nipannassa, evaṃ me āsi cetaso;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Icchamāno ahaṃ ajja, kilese jhāpaye mama.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Kiṃ me aññātavesena, dhammaṃ sacchikatenidha;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇitvā, buddho hessaṃ sadevake.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Kiṃ me ekena tiṇṇena, purisena thāmadassinā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇitvā, santāressaṃ sadevake.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Iminā me adhikārena, katena purisuttame;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇitvā, tāremi janataṃ bahuṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Saṃsārasotaṃ chinditvā, viddhaṃsetvā tayo bhave;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Dhammanāvaṃ samāruyha, santāressaṃ sadevake’”ti. (bu. vaṃ. 2.54-58);

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Yasmā pana buddhattaṃ patthentassa –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Manussattaṃ liṅgasampatti, hetu satthāradassanaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Pabbajjā guṇasampatti, adhikāro ca chandatā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Aṭṭhadhammasamodhānā, abhinīhāro samijjhatī”ti. (bu. vaṃ. 2.59);

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Manussattabhāvasmiṃyeva hi ṭhatvā buddhattaṃ patthentassa patthanā samijjhati, na nāgassa vā supaṇṇassa vā devatāya vā patthanā samijjhati.
Manussattabhāvepi purisaliṅge ṭhitasseva patthanā samijjhati, na itthiyā vā paṇḍakanapuṃsakaubhatobyañjanakānaṃ vā patthanā samijjhati.
Purisassāpi tasmiṃ attabhāve arahattappattiyā hetusampannasseva patthanā samijjhati, no itarassa.
Hetusampannassāpi jīvamānakabuddhasseva santike patthentassa patthanā samijjhati, parinibbute buddhe cetiyasantike vā bodhimūle vā patthentassa na samijjhati.
Buddhānaṃ santike patthentassāpi pabbajjāliṅge ṭhitasseva samijjhati, no gihiliṅge ṭhitassa.
Pabbajitassāpi pañcābhiññassa aṭṭhasamāpattilābhinoyeva samijjhati, na imāya guṇasampattiyā virahitassa.
Guṇasampannenāpi yena attano jīvitaṃ buddhānaṃ pariccattaṃ hoti, tassa iminā adhikārena adhikārasampannasseva samijjhati, na itarassa.
Adhikārasampannassāpi yassa buddhakārakadhammānaṃ atthāya mahanto chando ca ussāho ca vāyāmo ca pariyeṭṭhi ca, tasseva samijjhati, na itarassa.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tatridaṃ chandamahantatāya opammaṃ – sace hi evamassa “yo sakalacakkavāḷagabbhaṃ ekodakībhūtaṃ attano bāhubalena uttaritvā pāraṃ gantuṃ samattho, so buddhattaṃ pāpuṇāti.
Yo vā pana sakalacakkavāḷagabbhaṃ veḷugumbasañchannaṃ byūhitvā madditvā padasā gacchanto pāraṃ gantuṃ samattho, so buddhattaṃ pāpuṇāti.
Yo vā pana sakalacakkavāḷagabbhaṃ sattiyo ākoṭetvā nirantaraṃ sattiphalasamākiṇṇaṃ padasā akkamamāno pāraṃ gantuṃ samattho, so buddhattaṃ pāpuṇāti.
Yo vā pana sakalacakkavāḷagabbhaṃ vītaccitaṅgārabharitaṃ pādehi maddamāno pāraṃ gantuṃ samattho, so buddhattaṃ pāpuṇātī”ti.

Yo etesu ekampi attano dukkaraṃ na maññati, “ahaṃ etampi taritvā vā gantvā vā pāraṃ gahessāmī”ti evaṃ mahantena chandena ca ussāhena ca vāyāmena ca pariyeṭṭhiyā ca samannāgato hoti, tassa patthanā samijjhati, na itarassa.
Sumedhatāpaso pana ime aṭṭha dhamme samodhānetvā buddhabhāvāya abhinīhāraṃ katvā nipajji.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Dīpaṅkaropi bhagavā āgantvā sumedhatāpasassa sīsabhāge ṭhatvā maṇisīhapañjaraṃ ugghāṭento viya pañcavaṇṇappasādasampannāni akkhīni ummīletvā kalalapiṭṭhe nipannaṃ sumedhatāpasaṃ disvā “ayaṃ tāpaso buddhattāya abhinīhāraṃ katvā nipanno, ijjhissati nu kho imassa patthanā, udāhu no”ti anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ pesetvā upadhārento “ito kappasatasahassādhikāni cattāri asaṅkhyeyyāni atikkamitvā gotamo nāma buddho bhavissatī”ti ñatvā ṭhitakova parisamajjhe byākāsi –
“passatha no tumhe imaṃ uggatapaṃ tāpasaṃ kalalapiṭṭhe nipanna”nti?
“Evaṃ, bhante”ti.
“Ayaṃ buddhattāya abhinīhāraṃ katvā nipanno, samijjhissati imassa patthanā, ito kappasatasahassādhikānaṃ catunnaṃ asaṅkhyeyyānaṃ matthake gotamo nāma buddho bhavissati.

Tasmiṃ panassa attabhāve kapilavatthu nāma nagaraṃ nivāso bhavissati, māyā nāma devī mātā, suddhodano nāma rājā pitā, aggasāvako upatisso nāma thero, dutiyasāvako kolito nāma, buddhupaṭṭhāko ānando nāma, aggasāvikā khemā nāma therī, dutiyasāvikā uppalavaṇṇā nāma therī bhavissati, paripakkañāṇo mahābhinikkhamanaṃ katvā mahāpadhānaṃ padahitvā nigrodhamūle pāyāsaṃ paṭiggahetvā nerañjarāya tīre paribhuñjitvā bodhimaṇḍaṃ āruyha assattharukkhamūle abhisambujjhissatī”ti.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Dīpaṅkaro lokavidū, āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Ussīsake maṃ ṭhatvāna, idaṃ vacanamabravi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Passatha imaṃ tāpasaṃ, jaṭilaṃ uggatāpanaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Aparimeyye ito kappe, buddho loke bhavissati.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Ahu kapilavhayā rammā, nikkhamitvā tathāgato;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Padhānaṃ padahitvāna, katvā dukkarakārikaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Ajapālarukkhamūle, nisīditvā tathāgato;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tattha pāyāsaṃ paggayha, nerañjaramupehiti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Nerañjarāya tīramhi, pāyāsaṃ ada so jino;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Paṭiyattavaramaggena, bodhimūlamūpehiti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Tato padakkhiṇaṃ katvā, bodhimaṇḍaṃ anuttaro;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Assattharukkhamūlamhi, bujjhissati mahāyaso.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Imassa janikā mātā, māyā nāma bhavissati;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Pitā suddhodano nāma, ayaṃ hessati gotamo.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Anāsavā vītarāgā, santacittā samāhitā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Kolito upatisso ca, aggā hessanti sāvakā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Ānando nāmupaṭṭhāko, upaṭṭhissati taṃ jinaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Khemā uppalavaṇṇā ca, aggā hessanti sāvikā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Anāsavā vītarāgā, santacittā samāhitā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Bodhi tassa bhagavato, assatthoti pavuccatī’”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Sumedhatāpaso “mayhaṃ kira patthanā samijjhissatī”ti somanassappatto ahosi.
Mahājano dīpaṅkaradasabalassa vacanaṃ sutvā “sumedhatāpaso kira buddhabījaṃ buddhaṅkuro”ti haṭṭhatuṭṭho ahosi.

Evañcassa ahosi “yathā nāma puriso nadiṃ taranto ujukena titthena uttarituṃ asakkonto heṭṭhātitthena uttarati, evameva mayampi dīpaṅkaradasabalassa sāsane maggaphalaṃ alabhamānā anāgate yadā tvaṃ buddho bhavissasi, tadā tava sammukhā maggaphalaṃ sacchikātuṃ samatthā bhaveyyāmā”ti patthanaṃ ṭhapayiṃsu.

Dīpaṅkaradasabalopi bodhisattaṃ pasaṃsitvā aṭṭhahi pupphamuṭṭhīhi pūjetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi, tepi catusatasahassasaṅkhā khīṇāsavā bodhisattaṃ gandhehi ca mālehi ca pūjetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu.
Devamanussā pana tatheva pūjetvā vanditvā pakkantā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Bodhisatto sabbesaṃ paṭikkantakāle sayanā vuṭṭhāya “pāramiyo vicinissāmī”ti puppharāsimatthake pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā nisīdi.

Evaṃ nisinne bodhisatte sakaladasasahassacakkavāḷadevatā sannipatitvā sādhukāraṃ datvā “ayya sumedhatāpasa, porāṇakabodhisattānaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ‘pāramiyo vicinissāmā’ti nisinnakāle yāni pubbanimittāni nāma paññāyanti, tāni sabbānipi ajja pātubhūtāni, nissaṃsayena tvaṃ buddho bhavissasi, mayampetaṃ jānāma ‘yassetāni nimittāni paññāyanti, ekantena so buddho hoti’, tvaṃ attano vīriyaṃ daḷhaṃ katvā paggaṇhā”ti bodhisattaṃ nānappakārāhi thutīhi abhitthuniṃsu.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Idaṃ sutvāna vacanaṃ, asamassa mahesino;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Āmoditā naramarū, buddhabījaṃ kira ayaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Ukkuṭṭhisaddā vattanti, apphoṭenti hasanti ca;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Katañjalī namassanti, dasasahassī sadevakā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Yadimassa lokanāthassa, virajjhissāma sāsanaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Anāgatamhi addhāne, hessāma sammukhā imaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Yathā manussā nadiṃ tarantā, paṭibhitthaṃ virajjhiya;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Heṭṭhātitthe gahetvāna, uttaranti mahānadiṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Evameva mayaṃ sabbe, yadi muñcāmimaṃ jinaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Anāgatamhi addhāne, hessāma sammukhā imaṃ’.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Dīpaṅkaro lokavidū, āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Mama kammaṃ pakittetvā, dakkhiṇaṃ pādamuddhari.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Ye tatthāsuṃ jinaputtā, sabbe padakkhiṇamakaṃsu maṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Narā nāgā ca gandhabbā, abhivādetvāna pakkamuṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Dassanaṃ me atikkante, sasaṅghe lokanāyake;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Haṭṭhatuṭṭhena cittena, āsanā vuṭṭhahiṃ tadā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Sukhena sukhito homi, pāmojjena pamodito;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Pītiyā ca abhissanno, pallaṅkaṃ ābhujiṃ tadā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Pallaṅkena nisīditvā, evaṃ cintesahaṃ tadā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Vasībhūto ahaṃ jhāne, abhiññāsu pāramiṃ gato.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Sahassiyamhi lokamhi, isayo natthi me samā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Asamo iddhidhammesu, alabhiṃ īdisaṃ sukhaṃ’.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Pallaṅkābhujane mayhaṃ, dasasahassādhivāsino;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Mahānādaṃ pavattesuṃ, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Yā pubbe bodhisattānaṃ, pallaṅkavaramābhuje;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Nimittāni padissanti, tāni ajja padissare.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Sītaṃ byapagataṃ hoti, uṇhañca upasammati;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tāni ajja padissanti, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Dasasahassī lokadhātū, nissaddā honti nirākulā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tāni ajja padissanti, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Mahāvātā na vāyanti, na sandanti savantiyo;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tāni ajja padissanti, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Thalajā dakajā pupphā, sabbe pupphanti tāvade;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tepajja pupphitā sabbe, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Latā vā yadi vā rukkhā, phalabhārā honti tāvade;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tepajja phalitā sabbe, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Ākāsaṭṭhā ca bhūmaṭṭhā, ratanā jotanti tāvade;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tepajja ratanā jotanti, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Mānusakā ca dibbā ca, turiyā vajjanti tāvade;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tepajjubho abhiravanti, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Vicittapupphā gaganā, abhivassanti tāvade;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tepi ajja pavassanti, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Mahāsamuddo ābhujati, dasasahassī pakampati;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tepajjubho abhiravanti, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Nirayepi dasasahasse, aggī nibbanti tāvade;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tepajja nibbutā aggī, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Vimalo hoti sūriyo, sabbā dissanti tārakā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tepi ajja padissanti, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Anovaṭṭhena udakaṃ, mahiyā ubbhijji tāvade;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tampajjubbhijjate mahiyā, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Tārāgaṇā virocanti, nakkhattā gaganamaṇḍale;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Visākhā candimāyuttā, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Bilāsayā darīsayā, nikkhamanti sakāsayā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tepajja āsayā chuddhā, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Na hoti arati sattānaṃ, santuṭṭhā honti tāvade;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tepajja sabbe santuṭṭhā, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Rogā tadūpasammanti, jighacchā ca vinassati;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tānipajja padissanti, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Rāgo tadā tanu hoti, doso moho vinassati;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tepajja vigatā sabbe, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Bhayaṃ tadā na bhavati, ajjapetaṃ padissati;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tena liṅgena jānāma, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Rajo nuddhaṃsati uddhaṃ, ajjapetaṃ padissati;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tena liṅgena jānāma, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Aniṭṭhagandho pakkamati, diṭṭhagandho pavāyati;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Sopajja vāyati gandho, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Sabbe devā padissanti, ṭhapayitvā arūpino;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tepajja sabbe dissanti, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Yāvatā nirayā nāma, sabbe dissanti tāvade;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tepajja sabbe dissanti, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Kuṭṭā kavāṭā selā ca, na hontāvaraṇā tadā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Ākāsabhūtā tepajja, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Cutī ca upapatti ca, khaṇe tasmiṃ na vijjati;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tānipajja padissanti, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Daḷhaṃ paggaṇha vīriyaṃ, mā nivatta abhikkama;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Mayampetaṃ vijānāma, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavissasī’”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Bodhisatto dīpaṅkaradasabalassa ca dasasahassacakkavāḷadevatānañca vacanaṃ sutvā bhiyyoso mattāya sañjātussāho hutvā cintesi “buddhā nāma amoghavacanā, natthi buddhānaṃ kathāya aññathattaṃ.

Yathā hi ākāse khittaleḍḍussa patanaṃ dhuvaṃ, jātassa maraṇaṃ dhuvaṃ, aruṇe uggate sūriyassuṭṭhānaṃ, āsayā nikkhantasīhassa sīhanādanadanaṃ, garugabbhāya itthiyā bhāramoropanaṃ avassaṃbhāvī, evameva buddhānaṃ vacanaṃ nāma dhuvaṃ amoghaṃ, addhā ahaṃ buddho bhavissāmī”ti.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Buddhassa vacanaṃ sutvā, dasasahassīna cūbhayaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tuṭṭhahaṭṭho pamodito, evaṃ cintesahaṃ tadā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Advejjhavacanā buddhā, amoghavacanā jinā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Vitathaṃ natthi buddhānaṃ, dhuvaṃ buddho bhavāmahaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathā khittaṃ nabhe leḍḍu, dhuvaṃ patati bhūmiyaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tatheva buddhaseṭṭhānaṃ, vacanaṃ dhuvasassataṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathāpi sabbasattānaṃ, maraṇaṃ dhuvasassataṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tatheva buddhaseṭṭhānaṃ, vacanaṃ dhuvasassataṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathā rattikkhaye patte, sūriyuggamanaṃ dhuvaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tatheva buddhaseṭṭhānaṃ, vacanaṃ dhuvasassataṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathā nikkhantasayanassa, sīhassa nadanaṃ dhuvaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tatheva buddhaseṭṭhānaṃ, vacanaṃ dhuvasassataṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathā āpannasattānaṃ, bhāramoropanaṃ dhuvaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tatheva buddhaseṭṭhānaṃ, vacanaṃ dhuvasassata”nti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: So “dhuvāhaṃ buddho bhavissāmī”ti evaṃ katasanniṭṭhāno buddhakārake dhamme upadhāretuṃ “kahaṃ nu kho buddhakārakadhammā, kiṃ uddhaṃ, udāhu adho, disāsu, vidisāsū”ti anukkamena sakalaṃ dhammadhātuṃ vicinanto porāṇakabodhisattehi āsevitanisevitaṃ paṭhamaṃ dānapāramiṃ disvā evaṃ attānaṃ ovadi –
“sumedhapaṇḍita, tvaṃ ito paṭṭhāya paṭhamaṃ dānapāramiṃ pūreyyāsi.

Yathā hi nikkujjito udakakumbho nissesaṃ katvā udakaṃ vamatiyeva, na paccāharati, evameva dhanaṃ vā yasaṃ vā puttaṃ vā dāraṃ vā aṅgapaccaṅgaṃ vā anoloketvā sampattayācakānaṃ sabbaṃ icchiticchitaṃ nissesaṃ katvā dadamāno bodhirukkhamūle nisīditvā buddho bhavissasī”ti paṭhamaṃ dānapāramiṃ daḷhaṃ katvā adhiṭṭhāsi.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Handa buddhakare dhamme, vicināmi ito cito;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Uddhaṃ adho dasa disā, yāvatā dhammadhātuyā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Vicinanto tadādakkhiṃ, paṭhamaṃ dānapāramiṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Pubbakehi mahesīhi, anuciṇṇaṃ mahāpathaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Imaṃ tvaṃ paṭhamaṃ tāva, daḷhaṃ katvā samādiya;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Dānapāramitaṃ gaccha, yadi bodhiṃ pattumicchasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathāpi kumbho sampuṇṇo, yassa kassaci adhokato;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Vamatevudakaṃ nissesaṃ, na tattha parirakkhati.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Tatheva yācake disvā, hīnamukkaṭṭhamajjhime;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Dadāhi dānaṃ nissesaṃ, kumbho viya adhokato”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Athassa “na ettakeheva buddhakārakadhammehi bhavitabba”nti uttaripi upadhārayato dutiyaṃ sīlapāramiṃ disvā etadahosi –
“sumedhapaṇḍita, tvaṃ ito paṭṭhāya sīlapāramimpi pūreyyāsi.

Yathā hi camarīmigo nāma jīvitampi anoloketvā attano vālameva rakkhati, evaṃ tvampi ito paṭṭhāya jīvitampi anoloketvā sīlameva rakkhanto buddho bhavissasī”ti dutiyaṃ sīlapāramiṃ daḷhaṃ katvā adhiṭṭhāsi.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Na hete ettakāyeva, buddhadhammā bhavissare;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Aññepi vicinissāmi, ye dhammā bodhipācanā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Vicinanto tadādakkhiṃ, dutiyaṃ sīlapāramiṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Pubbakehi mahesīhi, āsevitanisevitaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Imaṃ tvaṃ dutiyaṃ tāva, daḷhaṃ katvā samādiya;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Sīlapāramitaṃ gaccha, yadi bodhiṃ pattumicchasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathāpi camarī vālaṃ, kismiñci paṭilaggitaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Upeti maraṇaṃ tattha, na vikopeti vāladhiṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Tatheva catūsu, bhūmīsu, sīlāni paripūraya;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Parirakkha sabbadā sīlaṃ, camarī viya vāladhi”nti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Athassa “na ettakeheva buddhakārakadhammehi bhavitabba”nti uttaripi upadhārayato tatiyaṃ nekkhammapāramiṃ disvā etadahosi “sumedhapaṇḍita, tvaṃ ito paṭṭhāya nekkhammapāramimpi pūreyyāsi.

Yathā hi ciraṃ bandhanāgāre vasamāno puriso na tattha sinehaṃ karoti, atha kho ukkaṇṭhitoyeva avasitukāmo hoti, evameva tvampi sabbabhave bandhanāgārasadise katvā sabbabhavehi ukkaṇṭhito muccitukāmo hutvā nekkhammābhimukhova hohi, evaṃ buddho bhavissasī”ti tatiyaṃ nekkhammapāramiṃ daḷhaṃ katvā adhiṭṭhāsi.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Na hete ettakāyeva, buddhadhammā bhavissare;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Aññepi vicinissāmi, ye dhammā bodhipācanā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Vicinanto tadādakkhiṃ, tatiyaṃ nekkhammapāramiṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Pubbakehi mahesīhi, āsevitanisevitaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Imaṃ tvaṃ tatiyaṃ tāva, daḷhaṃ katvā samādiya;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Nekkhammapāramitaṃ gaccha, yadi bodhiṃ pattumicchasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathā andughare puriso, ciravuttho dukhaṭṭito;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Na tattha rāgaṃ janeti, muttimeva gavesati.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Tatheva tvaṃ sabbabhave, passa andughare viya;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Nekkhammābhimukho hohi, bhavato parimuttiyā”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Athassa “na ettakeheva buddhakārakadhammehi bhavitabba”nti uttaripi upadhārayato catutthaṃ paññāpāramiṃ disvā etadahosi –
“sumedhapaṇḍita, tvaṃ ito paṭṭhāya paññāpāramimpi pūreyyāsi.
Hīnamajjhimukkaṭṭhesu kañci avajjetvā sabbepi paṇḍite upasaṅkamitvā pañhaṃ puccheyyāsi.

Yathā hi piṇḍacāriko bhikkhu hīnādikesu kulesu kiñci avajjetvā paṭipāṭiyā piṇḍāya caranto khippaṃ yāpanaṃ labhati, evaṃ tvampi sabbapaṇḍite upasaṅkamitvā pañhaṃ pucchanto buddho bhavissasī”ti catutthaṃ paññāpāramiṃ daḷhaṃ katvā adhiṭṭhāsi.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Na hete ettakāyeva, buddhadhammā bhavissare;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Aññepi vicinissāmi, ye dhammā bodhipācanā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Vicinanto tadādakkhiṃ, catutthaṃ paññāpāramiṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Pubbakehi mahesīhi, āsevitanisevitaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Imaṃ tvaṃ catutthaṃ tāva, daḷhaṃ katvā samādiya;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Paññāpāramitaṃ gaccha, yadi bodhiṃ pattumicchasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathāpi bhikkhu bhikkhanto, hīnamukkaṭṭhamajjhime;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Kulāni na vivajjento, evaṃ labhati yāpanaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Tatheva tvaṃ sabbakālaṃ, paripucchanto budhaṃ janaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Paññāpāramitaṃ gantvā, sambodhiṃ pāpuṇissasī”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Athassa “na ettakeheva buddhakārakadhammehi bhavitabba”nti uttaripi upadhārayato pañcamaṃ vīriyapāramiṃ disvā etadahosi –
“sumedhapaṇḍita, tvaṃ ito paṭṭhāya vīriyapāramimpi pūreyyāsi.

Yathā hi sīho migarājā sabbairiyāpathesu daḷhavīriyo hoti, evaṃ tvampi sabbabhavesu sabbairiyāpathesu daḷhavīriyo anolīnavīriyo samāno buddho bhavissasī”ti pañcamaṃ vīriyapāramiṃ daḷhaṃ katvā adhiṭṭhāsi.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Na hete ettakāyeva, buddhadhammā bhavissare;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Aññepi vicinissāmi, ye dhammā bodhipācanā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Vicinanto tadādakkhiṃ, pañcamaṃ vīriyapāramiṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Pubbakehi mahesīhi, āsevitanisevitaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Imaṃ tvaṃ pañcamaṃ tāva, daḷhaṃ katvā samādiya;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Vīriyapāramitaṃ gaccha, yadi bodhiṃ pattumicchasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathāpi sīho migarājā, nisajjaṭṭhānacaṅkame;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Alīnavīriyo hoti, paggahitamano sadā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Tatheva tvaṃ sabbabhave, paggaṇha vīriyaṃ daḷhaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Vīriyapāramitaṃ gantvā, sambodhiṃ pāpuṇissasī”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Athassa “na ettakeheva buddhakārakadhammehi bhavitabba”nti uttaripi upadhārayato chaṭṭhaṃ khantipāramiṃ disvā etadahosi –
“sumedhapaṇḍita, tvaṃ ito paṭṭhāya khantipāramimpi pūreyyāsi.
Sammānanepi avamānanepi khamova bhaveyyāsi.

Yathā hi pathaviyaṃ nāma sucimpi pakkhipanti asucimpi, na tena pathavī sinehaṃ, na paṭighaṃ karoti, khamati sahati adhivāsetiyeva, evaṃ tvampi sammānanāvamānanakkhamova samāno buddho bhavissasī”ti chaṭṭhaṃ khantipāramiṃ daḷhaṃ katvā adhiṭṭhāsi.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Na hete ettakāyeva, buddhadhammā bhavissare;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Aññepi vicinissāmi, ye dhammā bodhipācanā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Vicinanto tadādakkhiṃ, chaṭṭhamaṃ khantipāramiṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Pubbakehi mahesīhi, āsevitanisevitaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Imaṃ tvaṃ chaṭṭhamaṃ tāva, daḷhaṃ katvā samādiya;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tattha advejjhamānaso, sambodhiṃ pāpuṇissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathāpi pathavī nāma, sucimpi asucimpi ca;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Sabbaṃ sahati nikkhepaṃ, na karoti paṭighaṃ tayā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Tatheva tvampi sabbesaṃ, sammānāvamānakkhamo;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Khantipāramitaṃ gantvā, sambodhiṃ pāpuṇissasī”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Athassa “na ettakeheva buddhakārakadhammehi bhavitabba”nti uttaripi upadhārayato sattamaṃ saccapāramiṃ disvā etadahosi –
“sumedhapaṇḍita, tvaṃ ito paṭṭhāya saccapāramimpi pūreyyāsi.
Asaniyā matthake patamānāyapi dhanādīnaṃ atthāya chandādivasena sampajānamusāvādaṃ nāma mākāsi.

Yathā hi osadhitārakā nāma sabbautūsu attano gamanavīthiṃ jahitvā aññāya vīthiyā na gacchati, sakavīthiyāva gacchati, evameva tvampi saccaṃ pahāya musāvādaṃ nāma akarontoyeva buddho bhavissasī”ti sattamaṃ saccapāramiṃ daḷhaṃ katvā adhiṭṭhāsi.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Na hete ettakāyeva, buddhadhammā bhavissare;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Aññepi vicinissāmi, ye dhammā bodhipācanā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Vicinanto tadādakkhiṃ, sattamaṃ saccapāramiṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Pubbakehi mahesīhi, āsevitanisevitaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Imaṃ tvaṃ sattamaṃ tāva, daḷhaṃ katvā samādiya;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tattha advejjhavacano, sambodhiṃ pāpuṇissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathāpi osadhī nāma, tulābhūtā sadevake;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Samaye utuvasse vā, na vokkamati vīthito.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Tatheva tvampi saccesu, mā vokkamasi vīthito;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Saccapāramitaṃ gantvā, sambodhiṃ pāpuṇissasī”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Athassa “na ettakeheva buddhakārakadhammehi bhavitabba”nti uttaripi upadhārayato aṭṭhamaṃ adhiṭṭhānapāramiṃ disvā etadahosi –
“sumedhapaṇḍita, tvaṃ ito paṭṭhāya adhiṭṭhānapāramimpi pūreyyāsi.
Yaṃ adhiṭṭhāsi, tasmiṃ adhiṭṭhāne niccalo bhaveyyāsi.

Yathā hi pabbato nāma sabbadisāsu vātehi pahaṭopi na kampati na calati, attano ṭhāneyeva tiṭṭhati, evameva tvampi attano adhiṭṭhāne niccalo hontova buddho bhavissasī”ti aṭṭhamaṃ adhiṭṭhānapāramiṃ daḷhaṃ katvā adhiṭṭhāsi.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Na hete ettakāyeva, buddhadhammā bhavissare;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Aññepi vicinissāmi, ye dhammā bodhipācanā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Vicinanto tadādakkhiṃ, aṭṭhamaṃ adhiṭṭhānapāramiṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Pubbakehi mahesīhi, āsevitanisevitaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Imaṃ tvaṃ aṭṭhamaṃ tāva, daḷhaṃ katvā samādiya;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tattha tvaṃ acalo hutvā, sambodhiṃ pāpuṇissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathāpi pabbato selo, acalo suppatiṭṭhito;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Na kampati bhusavātehi, sakaṭṭhāneva tiṭṭhati.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Tatheva tvampi adhiṭṭhāne, sabbadā acalo bhava;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Adhiṭṭhānapāramitaṃ gantvā, sambodhiṃ pāpuṇissasī”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Athassa “na ettakeheva buddhakārakadhammehi bhavitabba”nti uttaripi upadhārayato navamaṃ mettāpāramiṃ disvā etadahosi –
“sumedhapaṇḍita, tvaṃ ito paṭṭhāya navamaṃ mettāpāramimpi pūreyyāsi.
Ahitesupi hitesupi ekacitto bhaveyyāsi.

Yathā hi udakaṃ nāma pāpajanassāpi kalyāṇajanassāpi sītibhāvaṃ ekasadisaṃ katvā pharati, evameva tvampi sabbasattesu mettacittena ekacittova honto buddho bhavissasī”ti navamaṃ mettāpāramiṃ daḷhaṃ katvā adhiṭṭhāsi.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Na hete ettakāyeva, buddhadhammā bhavissare;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Aññepi vicinissāmi, ye dhammā bodhipācanā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Vicinanto tadādakkhiṃ, navamaṃ mettāpāramiṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Pubbakehi mahesīhi, āsevitanisevitaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Imaṃ tvaṃ navamaṃ tāva, daḷhaṃ katvā samādiya;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Mettāya asamo hohi, yadi bodhiṃ pattumicchasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathāpi udakaṃ nāma, kalyāṇe pāpake jane;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Samaṃ pharati sītena, pavāheti rajomalaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Tatheva tvampi ahitahite, samaṃ mettāya bhāvaya;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Mettāpāramitaṃ gantvā, sambodhiṃ pāpuṇissasī”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Athassa “na ettakeheva buddhakārakadhammehi bhavitabba”nti uttaripi upadhārayato dasamaṃ upekkhāpāramiṃ disvā etadahosi –
“sumedhapaṇḍita, tvaṃ ito paṭṭhāya upekkhāpāramimpi pūreyyāsi.
Sukhepi dukkhepi majjhattova bhaveyyāsi.
Yathā hi pathavī nāma sucimpi asucimpi pakkhippamānā majjhattāva hoti, evameva tvampi sukhadukkhesu majjhattova honto buddho bhavissasī”ti dasamaṃ upekkhāpāramiṃ daḷhaṃ katvā adhiṭṭhāsi.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Na hete ettakāyeva, buddhadhammā bhavissare;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Aññepi vicinissāmi, ye dhammā bodhipācanā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Vicinanto tadādakkhiṃ, dasamaṃ upekkhāpāramiṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Pubbakehi mahesīhi, āsevitanisevitaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Imaṃ tvaṃ dasamaṃ tāva, daḷhaṃ katvā samādiya;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tulābhūto daḷho hutvā, sambodhiṃ pāpuṇissasi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathāpi pathavī nāma, nikkhittaṃ asuciṃ suciṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Upekkhati ubhopete, kopānunayavajjitā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Tatheva tvampi sukhadukkhe, tulābhūto sadā bhava;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Upekkhāpāramitaṃ gantvā, sambodhiṃ pāpuṇissasī”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tato cintesi –

“imasmiṃ loke bodhisattehi pūretabbā bodhiparipācanā buddhakārakadhammā ettakāyeva, dasa pāramiyo ṭhapetvā aññe natthi, imāpi dasa pāramiyo uddhaṃ ākāsepi natthi, heṭṭhā pathaviyampi, puratthimādīsu disāsupi natthi, mayhameva pana hadayamaṃsabbhantare patiṭṭhitā”ti.

Evaṃ tāsaṃ hadaye patiṭṭhitabhāvaṃ disvā sabbāpi tā daḷhaṃ katvā adhiṭṭhāya punappunaṃ sammasanto anulomapaṭilomaṃ sammasati, pariyante gahetvā ādiṃ pāpeti, ādimhi gahetvā pariyante ṭhapeti, majjhe gahetvā ubhato osāpeti, ubhato koṭīsu hetvā majjhe osāpeti.

Bāhirakabhaṇḍapariccāgo dānapāramī nāma, aṅgapariccāgo dānaupapāramī nāma, jīvitapariccāgo dānaparamatthapāramī nāmāti dasa pāramiyo dasa upapāramiyo dasa paramatthapāramiyo yantatelaṃ vinivaṭṭento viya mahāmeruṃ matthaṃ katvā cakkavāḷamahāsamuddaṃ āluḷento viya ca sammasi.

Tassevaṃ dasa pāramiyo sammasantassa dhammatejena catunahutādhikadviyojanasatasahassabahalā ayaṃ mahāpathavī hatthinā akkantanaḷakalāpo viya, pīḷiyamānaṃ ucchuyantaṃ viya ca mahāviravaṃ viravamānā saṅkampi sampakampi sampavedhi, kulālacakkaṃ viya telayantacakkaṃ viya ca paribbhami.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Ettakāyeva te loke, ye dhammā bodhipācanā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tatuddhaṃ natthi aññatra, daḷhaṃ tattha patiṭṭhaha.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Ime dhamme sammasato, sabhāvasarasalakkhaṇe;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Dhammatejena vasudhā, dasasahassī pakampatha.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Calatī ravatī pathavī, ucchuyantaṃva pīḷitaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Telayante yathā cakkaṃ, evaṃ kampati medanī”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Mahāpathaviyā kampamānāya rammanagaravāsino saṇṭhātuṃ asakkontā yugantavātabbhāhatā mahāsālā viya mucchitamucchitāva papatiṃsu, ghaṭādīni kulālabhājanāni pavaṭṭantāni aññamaññaṃ paharantāni cuṇṇavicuṇṇāni ahesuṃ.

Mahājano bhītatasito satthāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā “kiṃ nu kho bhagavā nāgāvaṭṭo ayaṃ bhūtayakkhadevatāsu aññatarāvaṭṭoti na hi mayaṃ etaṃ jānāma, apica kho sabbopi ayaṃ mahājano upadduto, kiṃ nu kho imassa lokassa pāpakaṃ bhavissati, udāhu kalyāṇaṃ, kathetha no etaṃ kāraṇa”nti āha.
Atha satthā tesaṃ kathaṃ sutvā “tumhe mā bhāyatha mā cintayittha, natthi vo itonidānaṃ bhayaṃ.

Yo so mayā ajja sumedhapaṇḍito ‘anāgate gotamo nāma buddho bhavissatī’ti byākato, so dasa pāramiyo sammasati, tassa dasa pāramiyo sammasantassa viloḷentassa dhammatejena sakaladasasahassilokadhātu ekappahārena kampati, ceva, ravati cā”ti āha.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yāvatā parisā āsi, buddhassa parivesane;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Pavedhamānā sā tattha, mucchitā sesi bhūmiyaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Ghaṭānekasahassāni, kumbhīnañca satā bahū;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Sañcuṇṇamathitā tattha, aññamaññaṃ paghaṭṭitā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Ubbiggā tasitā bhītā, bhantā byadhitamānasā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Mahājanā samāgamma, dīpaṅkaramupāgamuṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: ‘Kiṃ bhavissati lokassa, kalyāṇamatha pāpakaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Sabbo upadduto loko, taṃ vinodehi cakkhuma’.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Tesaṃ tadā saññāpesi, dīpaṅkaro mahāmuni;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Vissatthā hotha mā bhātha, imasmiṃ pathavikampane.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yamahaṃ ajja byākāsiṃ, buddho loke bhavissati;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Eso sammasati dhammaṃ, pubbakaṃ jinasevitaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Tassa sammasato dhammaṃ, buddhabhūmiṃ asesato;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tenāyaṃ kampitā pathavī, dasasahassī sadevake”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Mahājano tathāgatassa vacanaṃ sutvā haṭṭhatuṭṭho mālāgandhavilepanaṃ ādāya rammanagarā nikkhamitvā bodhisattaṃ upasaṅkamitvā mālādīhi pūjetvā vanditvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā rammanagarameva pāvisi.
Bodhisattopi dasa pāramiyo sammasitvā vīriyaṃ daḷhaṃ katvā adhiṭṭhāya nisinnāsanā vuṭṭhāsi.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Buddhassa vacanaṃ sutvā, mano nibbāyi tāvade;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Sabbe maṃ upasaṅkamma, punāpi abhivandisuṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Samādiyitvā buddhaguṇaṃ, daḷhaṃ katvāna mānasaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Dīpaṅkaraṃ namassitvā, āsanā vuṭṭhahiṃ tadā”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Atha bodhisattaṃ āsanā vuṭṭhahantaṃ sakaladasasahassacakkavāḷadevatā sannipatitvā dibbehi mālāgandhehi pūjetvā vanditvā “ayya sumedhatāpasa, tayā ajja dīpaṅkaradasabalassa pādamūle mahatī patthanā patthitā, sā te anantarāyena samijjhatu, mā te bhayaṃ vā chambhitattaṃ vā ahosi, sarīre appamattakopi rogo mā uppajji, khippaṃ pāramiyo pūretvā sammāsambodhiṃ paṭivijjha.

Yathā pupphūpagaphalūpagā rukkhā samaye pupphanti ceva phalanti ca, tatheva tvampi samayaṃ anatikkamitvā khippaṃ sambodhimuttamaṃ phusassū”tiādīni thutimaṅgalāni payirudāhaṃsu, evaṃ payirudāhitvā attano attano devaṭṭhānameva agamaṃsu.

Bodhisattopi devatāhi abhitthuto “ahaṃ dasa pāramiyo pūretvā kappasatasahassādhikānaṃ catunnaṃ asaṅkhyeyyānaṃ matthake buddho bhavissāmī”ti vīriyaṃ daḷhaṃ katvā adhiṭṭhāya nabhaṃ abbhuggantvā himavantameva agamāsi.
Tena vuttaṃ –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Dibbaṃ mānusakaṃ pupphaṃ, devā mānusakā ubho;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Samokiranti pupphehi, vuṭṭhahantassa āsanā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Vedayanti ca te sotthiṃ, devā mānusakā ubho;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Mahantaṃ patthitaṃ tuyhaṃ, taṃ labhassu yathicchitaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Sabbītiyo vivajjantu, soko rogo vinassatu;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Mā te bhavantvantarāyā, phusa khippaṃ bodhimuttamaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathāpi samaye patte, pupphanti pupphino dumā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tatheva tvaṃ mahāvīra, buddhañāṇena pupphassu.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathā ye keci sambuddhā, pūrayuṃ dasa pāramī;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tatheva tvaṃ mahāvīra, pūraya dasa pāramī.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathā ye keci sambuddhā, bodhimaṇḍamhi bujjhare;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tatheva tvaṃ mahāvīra, bujjhassu jinabodhiyaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathā ye keci sambuddhā, dhammacakkaṃ pavattayuṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tatheva tvaṃ mahāvīra, dhammacakkaṃ pavattaya.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Puṇṇamāye yathā cando, parisuddho virocati;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tatheva tvaṃ puṇṇamano, viroca dasasahassiyaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Rāhumutto yathā sūriyo, tāpena atirocati;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tatheva lokā muccitvā, viroca siriyā tuvaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yathā yā kāci nadiyo, osaranti mahodadhiṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Evaṃ sadevakā lokā, osarantu tavantike.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Tehi thutappasattho so, dasa dhamme samādiya;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Te dhamme paripūrento, pavanaṃ pāvisī tadā”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Sumedhakathā niṭṭhitā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Rammanagaravāsinopi kho nagaraṃ pavisitvā buddhappamukhassa bhikkhusaṅghassa mahādānaṃ adaṃsu.

Satthā tesaṃ dhammaṃ desetvā mahājanaṃ saraṇādīsu patiṭṭhāpetvā rammanagaramhā nikkhamitvā tato uddhampi yāvatāyukaṃ tiṭṭhanto sabbaṃ buddhakiccaṃ katvā anukkamena anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyi.
Tattha yaṃ vattabbaṃ, taṃ sabbaṃ buddhavaṃse vuttanayeneva veditabbaṃ.
Vuttañhi tattha –

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Tadā te bhojayitvāna, sasaṅghaṃ lokanāyakaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Upagacchuṃ saraṇaṃ tassa, dīpaṅkarassa satthuno.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Saraṇāgamane kañci, niveseti tathāgato;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Kañci pañcasu sīlesu, sīle dasavidhe paraṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Kassaci deti sāmaññaṃ, caturo phalamuttame;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Kassaci asame dhamme, deti so paṭisambhidā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Kassaci varasamāpattiyo, aṭṭha deti narāsabho;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tisso kassaci vijjāyo, chaḷabhiññā pavecchati.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Tena yogena janakāyaṃ, ovadati mahāmuni;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tena vitthārikaṃ āsi, lokanāthassa sāsanaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Mahāhanusabhakkhandho, dīpaṅkarasanāmako;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Bahū jane tārayati, parimoceti duggatiṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Bodhaneyyaṃ janaṃ disvā, satasahassepi yojane;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Khaṇena upagantvāna, bodheti taṃ mahāmuni.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Paṭhamābhisamaye buddho, koṭisatamabodhayi;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Dutiyābhisamaye nātho, navutikoṭimabodhayi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yadā ca devabhavanamhi, buddho dhammamadesayi;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Navutikoṭisahassānaṃ, tatiyābhisamayo ahu.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Sannipātā tayo āsuṃ, dīpaṅkarassa satthuno;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Koṭisatasahassānaṃ, paṭhamo āsi samāgamo.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Puna nāradakūṭamhi, pavivekagate jine;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Khīṇāsavā vītamalā, samiṃsu satakoṭiyo.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Yamhi kāle mahāvīro, sudassanasiluccaye;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Navutikoṭisahassehi, pavāresi mahāmuni.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Ahaṃ tena samayena, jaṭilo uggatāpano;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Antalikkhamhi caraṇo, pañcābhiññāsu pāragū.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Dasavīsasahassānaṃ, dhammābhisamayo ahu;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Ekadvinnaṃ abhisamayā, gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ, iddhaṃ phītaṃ ahu tadā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Dīpaṅkarassa bhagavato, sāsanaṃ suvisodhitaṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Cattāri satasahassāni, chaḷabhiññā mahiddhikā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Dīpaṅkaraṃ lokaviduṃ, parivārenti sabbadā.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Ye keci tena samayena, jahanti mānusaṃ bhavaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Apattamānasā sekkhā, garahitā bhavanti te.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Supupphitaṃ pāvacanaṃ, arahantehi tādihi;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Khīṇāsavehi vimalehi, upasobhati sadevake.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Nagaraṃ rammavatī nāma, sudevo nāma khattiyo;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Sumedhā nāma janikā, dīpaṅkarassa satthuno.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Sumaṅgalo ca tisso ca, ahesuṃ aggasāvakā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Sāgato nāmupaṭṭhāko, dīpaṅkarassa satthuno.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Nandā ceva sunandā ca, ahesuṃ aggasāvikā;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Bodhi tassa bhagavato, pipphalīti pavuccati.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Asītihatthamubbedho, dīpaṅkaro mahāmuni;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Sobhati dīparukkhova, sālarājāva phullito.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Satasahassavassāni, āyu tassa mahesino;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tāvatā tiṭṭhamāno so, tāresi janataṃ bahuṃ.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Jotayitvāna saddhammaṃ, santāretvā mahājanaṃ;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Jalitvā aggikhandhova, nibbuto so sasāvako.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Sā ca iddhi so ca yaso, tāni ca pādesu cakkaratanāni;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Sabbaṃ tamantarahitaṃ, nanu rittā sabbasaṅkhārā”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Dīpaṅkarassa pana bhagavato aparabhāge ekaṃ asaṅkhyeyyaṃ atikkamitvā koṇḍañño nāma satthā udapādi.
Tassāpi tayo sāvakasannipātā ahesuṃ.
Paṭhamasannipāte koṭisatasahassaṃ, dutiye koṭisahassaṃ, tatiye navutikoṭiyo.
Tadā bodhisatto vijitāvī nāma cakkavattī hutvā koṭisatasahassasaṅkhassa buddhappamukhassa bhikkhusaṅghassa mahādānaṃ adāsi.
Satthā bodhisattaṃ “buddho bhavissasī”ti byākaritvā dhammaṃ desesi.
So satthu dhammakathaṃ sutvā rajjaṃ niyyādetvā pabbaji.
So tīṇi piṭakāni uggahetvā aṭṭha samāpattiyo pañca abhiññāyo ca uppādetvā aparihīnajjhāno brahmaloke nibbatti.

Koṇḍaññassa buddhassa pana rammavatī nāma nagaraṃ, sunando nāma khattiyo pitā, sujātā nāma devī mātā, bhaddo ca subhaddo ca dve aggasāvakā, anuruddho nāmupaṭṭhāko, tissā ca upatissā ca dve aggasāvikā, sālakalyāṇī bodhi, aṭṭhāsītihatthubbedhaṃ sarīraṃ, vassasatasahassaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: “Dīpaṅkarassa aparena, koṇḍañño nāma nāyako;

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Anantatejo amitayaso, appameyyo durāsado”ti.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Tassa aparabhāge ekaṃ asaṅkhyeyyaṃ atikkamitvā ekasmiṃyeva kappe caturo buddhā nibbattiṃsu maṅgalo, sumano, revato, sobhitoti.
Maṅgalassa bhagavato tayo sannipātā ahesuṃ.
Tesu paṭhamasannipāte koṭisatasahassaṃ bhikkhū ahesuṃ, dutiye koṭisahassaṃ, tatiye navutikoṭiyo.
Vemātikabhātā kirassa ānandakumāro nāma navutikoṭisaṅkhāya parisāya saddhiṃ dhammassavanatthāya satthu santikaṃ agamāsi.
Satthā tassa anupubbiṃ kathaṃ kathesi, so saddhiṃ parisāya saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.
Satthā tesaṃ kulaputtānaṃ pubbacaritaṃ olokento iddhimayapattacīvarassa upanissayaṃ disvā dakkhiṇahatthaṃ pasāretvā “etha, bhikkhavo”ti āha.
Sabbe taṅkhaṇaññeva iddhimayapattacīvaradharā saṭṭhivassamahātherā viya ākappasampannā hutvā satthāraṃ vanditvā parivārayiṃsu.
Ayamassa tatiyo sāvakasannipāto ahosi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Yathā pana aññesaṃ buddhānaṃ samantā asītihatthappamāṇāyeva sarīrappabhā ahosi, na evaṃ tassa tassa pana bhagavato sarīrappabhā niccakālaṃ dasasahassilokadhātuṃ pharitvā aṭṭhāsi.
Rukkhapathavipabbatasamuddādayo antamaso ukkhalikādīni upādāya suvaṇṇapaṭṭapariyonaddhā viya ahesuṃ.
Āyuppamāṇaṃ panassa navutivassasahassāni ahosi.
Ettakaṃ kālaṃ candimasūriyādayo attano pabhāya virocituṃ nāsakkhiṃsu, rattindivaparicchedo na paññāyittha.
Divā sūriyālokena viya sattā niccaṃ buddhālokeneva vicariṃsu, sāyaṃ pupphitakusumānaṃ, pāto ravanakasakuṇādīnañca vasena loko rattindivaparicchedaṃ sallakkhesi.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Kiṃ pana aññesaṃ buddhānaṃ ayamānubhāvo natthīti?
No natthi.
Tepi hi ākaṅkhamānā dasasahassiṃ vā lokadhātuṃ tato vā bhiyyo ābhāya phareyyuṃ.
Maṅgalassa pana bhagavato pubbapatthanāvasena aññesaṃ byāmappabhā viya sarīrappabhā niccakālameva dasasahassilokadhātuṃ pharitvā aṭṭhāsi.
So kira bodhisattacariyakāle vessantarasadise attabhāve ṭhito saputtadāro vaṅkapabbatasadise pabbate vasi.
Atheko kharadāṭhiko nāma yakkho mahāpurisassa dānajjhāsayataṃ sutvā brāhmaṇavaṇṇena upasaṅkamitvā mahāsattaṃ dve dārake yāci.
Mahāsatto “dadāmi brāhmaṇassa puttake”ti haṭṭhapahaṭṭho udakapariyantaṃ pathaviṃ kampento dvepi dārake adāsi.
Yakkho caṅkamanakoṭiyaṃ ālambanaphalakaṃ nissāya ṭhatvā passantasseva mahāsattassa mūlakalāpe viya dve dārake khādi.
Mahāpurisassa yakkhaṃ oloketvā mukhe vivaṭamatte aggijālaṃ viya lohitadhāraṃ uggiramānaṃ tassa mukhaṃ disvāpi kesaggamattampi domanassaṃ na uppajji.
“Sudinnaṃ vata me dāna”nti cintayato panassa sarīre mahantaṃ pītisomanassa udapādi.
So “imassa me nissandena anāgate imināva nīhārena rasmiyo nikkhamantū”ti patthanaṃ akāsi.
Tassa taṃ patthanaṃ nissāya buddhabhūtassa sarīrato rasmiyo nikkhamitvā ettakaṃ ṭhānaṃ phariṃsu.

before.title: Sumedhakathā
lines: Aparampissa pubbacaritaṃ atthi.
